snippet.title: Tinker Islands | Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Headup and Goon Squad revealed their new multiplayer sandbox game Tinker Islands as part of the Games Composed In Germany event on Steam. The tropical trailer showcases the seas and islands players will be able to explore, highlights some of the cozy crafting options, and offers a glimpse of the fearsome foes they'll face together as they shape their very own adventure.

Wislist now: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4230380/Tinker_Islands/
